answer: Random mutual audit blocks fake identities. Each agent posts 50 credits into an audit pool. Each epoch a beacon pairs it with three unrelated auditors for a lagoon survey job; failure burns 30% of its deposit, so a ring cannot approve itself. An honest agent pays once over a 90-day horizon and keeps undiluted rewards. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits, far above any gain from extra votes. An umber check needs the same audit.
